artDefaults.promptSuffix: Three Kingdoms fantasy strategy card illustration, dramatic painterly 2D digital art, strong silhouette, ancient Chinese battlefield atmosphere, no text, no watermark, no card frame.

cards.title: 杀
cards.prompt: Sha attack card, a decisive killing strike by a Three Kingdoms warrior, crimson spear slash across a chaotic battlefield, sparks and dust.

cards.title: 闪
cards.prompt: Shan dodge card, an agile Three Kingdoms warrior evading arrows and blades with a blue-white afterimage, defensive motion and wind trails.

cards.title: 桃
cards.description: 回复生命并获得格挡。若生命不高于一半，额外回复生命。
cards.prompt: Tao peach healing card, luminous peaches and medicinal light in an ancient military tent, wounded warriors recovering, warm peach petals.

cards.title: 酒
cards.description: 下一张攻击牌造成的伤害翻倍。
cards.prompt: Jiu wine power card, a fierce general drinks from a bronze cup before battle, red aura and rising strength, war drums in torchlight.

cards.title: 刺杀
cards.description: 造成伤害。若目标没有格挡，额外造成伤害。
cards.prompt: Ci Sha assassination attack card, a Three Kingdoms shadow warrior lunges from behind torn war banners, precise crimson blade, tense battlefield dusk.

cards.title: 守势
cards.description: 获得格挡。若本回合还没有打出过杀，抽牌。
cards.prompt: Shou Shi defensive stance card, a disciplined shield wall of ancient Chinese soldiers holding formation in rain, calm commander, blue steel light.

cards.title: 调度
cards.prompt: Diao Du tactical dispatch card, messengers move command flags across a military map, troops redeploying at dawn, efficient battlefield logistics.

cards.title: 仁德
cards.description: 弃 1 张手牌，回复生命并获得格挡。若弃掉技能牌，抽牌。
cards.prompt: Ren De benevolence card, Liu Bei-like noble leader gives supplies to wounded soldiers, warm golden light, banners of loyalty and compassion.

cards.title: 突袭
cards.description: 抽牌。目标失去力量；若目标没有力量，改为施加易伤。
cards.prompt: Tu Xi surprise raid card, Zhang Liao-style cavalry bursts from fog into enemy camp, stolen banners and startled soldiers, cold blue morning.

cards.title: 奇袭
cards.description: 消耗 1 张技能牌，移除目标所有格挡并施加易伤。
cards.prompt: Qi Xi cunning raid card, Gan Ning night assault with bells and black sails, a swift strike breaks enemy defenses, moonlit river ambush.

cards.title: 刮骨疗毒
cards.description: 消耗。移除自身所有负面效果；每移除 1 个，回复生命。若没有负面效果，抽牌。
cards.prompt: Gua Gu Liao Du bone-scraping cure card, Hua Tuo-like physician treats a stoic wounded general, surgical bronze tools, green healing aura.

cards.title: 空城
cards.description: 获得格挡。每回合首次打出牌后若没有手牌，获得无实体。
cards.prompt: Empty Fort strategy, Zhuge Liang calmly plays a qin on an open city gate while enemy scouts hesitate before silent walls and drifting banners.

cards.title: 制衡
cards.description: 可消耗手牌并抽等量牌，额外抽牌。此后每回合首次打出技能牌后抽牌。
cards.prompt: Sun Quan balancing strategy, a young ruler rearranges military tokens and cards on a jade war table, advisors watching, golden command light.

cards.title: 无双
cards.description: 能力。每回合前若干次杀命中后追加无双伤害；追加伤害不触发杀命中。
cards.prompt: Lu Bu unrivaled power, an unstoppable halberd warrior surrounded by red-black battle aura, enemies thrown back, legendary dominance.

cards.title: 连营
cards.description: 能力。打空手牌后抽牌，并使 1 张杀或技能牌本回合费用降低 1。
cards.prompt: Lu Xun chain-camp tactics, burning connected camps at night transforming into flowing strategy cards, calm scholar-general directing momentum.

cards.title: 遗计
cards.description: 抽牌。每回合首次敌人即将造成伤害时抽牌；手牌少时额外抽牌并临时降低杀或技能牌费用。
cards.prompt: Guo Jia last strategy, a pale brilliant adviser leaves glowing scrolls and chess pieces after a wound, allies receiving hidden plans.

cards.title: 奸雄
cards.description: 获得力量。敌人首次即将造成伤害时抽牌，并强化下一张杀。
cards.prompt: Cao Cao ambitious hero ability, a commanding warlord in black armor gathers enemy schemes into his hand, storm banners and ruthless confidence.

cards.title: 鬼才
cards.description: 获得格挡。敌人即将造成伤害时判定牌堆顶，并根据牌型获得格挡、抽牌、虚弱或减费。
cards.prompt: Sima Yi ghost talent, a shadowy strategist manipulates fate cards under a cold moon, black feathers, calculating eyes, supernatural judgment.
